Product overview

F29R is the race-oriented model in the Time-F electric off-road series, combining 32 kW peak power, a 96V55Ah battery, three selectable ride modes and IP67 protection.

Synchronous motorPermanent-magnet drive with 32 kW maximum power.
High-voltage battery96V55Ah pack with a stated four-hour charging time.
Full-size chassis1440 mm wheelbase, 340 mm clearance and 910 mm seat height.
Disc brakesFront and rear disc braking for off-road control.
